path_convention: Paths are relative to Godot_Sim2Sim for Lab, repository root for Art. legacy_paths are exact paths, never prefix exemptions.

groups.edit_policy: Normal existing-file fixes remain in place. New self-authored Godot files use the engineering rules; do not split physics/controller/observation/action interfaces in this cleanup.

groups.source: Existing conversion/preparation functions in src and scripts; tracked source assets retain upstream provenance.
groups.edit_policy: Use existing preparation flow under separately authorized runtime work; not an independent active source.
Retain import/override order and callers. Do not develop both copies; choose and record the exact source before a new change. Transfer of the still-active Art implementation is deferred.

groups.source: Each existing provenance/license and policy contract; equality does not establish authorship.
groups.edit_policy: Preserve policy weights, imported models, license and source records; no bulk rename or deletion.
Experiment baselines and evidence are persistent. Temporary scan outputs stay outside versioned directories.

compared_revisions.comparison_method: SHA256 of tracked files in clean worktrees at these committed revisions; excludes live uncommitted work. Counts below apply only to the named compared groups, not every file in either repository.
